units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 67b:21">Snh. 67ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 8:2">Ex. VIII, 2</cite>) <he>צ׳ אחת היתה וכ׳</he> originally there was only one frog &c.; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 10:4">Ex. R. s. 10</cite>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 10:6">Ib.</cite> <he>אני עושה שליחותי … ע״י צ׳</he> I have my message carried, and be it even through a serpent, a scorpion or a frog; a. fr.—Pl. <he>צְפַרְדְּעִים</he>, <he>צְפַרְדְּעִין</he>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 10:4">Ib.</cite> <he>השחתת הצ׳</he> the ruin which the frogs effected. Pesik. Vayhi, p. 66ᵇ <he>ואח״כ … קולנין</he> (<cite ref="K00096"><he>כגון</he></cite>) <he>צ׳</he> and then he sent them criers (heralds), that is the frogs; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 17:1">Pesik. R. s. 17</cite>; a. e.
